scope: Local BNB fork with actual WBNB and PancakeSwap V2. CoreHarness is a settlement adapter, not official OpenFour Core.

contract_tests.title: keeps implementation bytecode deployable and round-trips the official token tuple schema
applies custom buy and per-purchase sell rates on launch day and day 20
uses the exact daily sell and weight arrays exported by the UI
requires both eligibility and minimum funding, then enforces custom cadence
divides actual BNB funding by the configured 3x and 1x weights
allocates the selected treasury percentages without crossing budgets
does not transfer acquisition age, and protects initialization from unrelated callers
rejects invalid curves, funding cadence and split before token creation
validates the exported launch tuple and rejects mismatched infrastructure and inventory
retains age taxation and treasury processing through real PancakeSwap graduation

model_checks: Default parity, 600 curve configurations, loyalty bounds, invalid settings, revenue conservation, export round-trip.
limits: Official OpenFour Core integration and preset registration pending
